title: [3.0.0.1] Profile editor - basal graph shown in IC tab
body:
I took screenshots of the different tabs in the Profile tab, and noticed the display graph below the IC ratios doesn't show IC but rather a copy of the basal rates graph. 
Checked in both AndroidAPS and NSClient phones and it's the same for both.
